header.title: China's rise as a biopharma innovator creates partnership upside and competitive risk

s01_bottom_line.text: Executives say China has gone from fast follower to genuine innovator, innovating faster and at lower cost; US/European firms seek partnerships with Chinese labs while flagging due diligence and national security guardrails.
The article frames China as creating opportunities for global partnerships while raising competition and risk.

The article presents China's biotech rise as both an opportunity (partnerships, access to novel molecules) and a competitive risk to US/European incumbents, without naming affected listed companies or quantifying share shift.

items.text: China has moved from fast follower to genuine innovator in biopharma/biotech, per Laaman.
China innovates faster and at lower cost than global competitors, creating both opportunities and risks.
Executives emphasized the need for rigorous due diligence and guardrails, including national security measures, before entering China partnerships.
